concept.title: People wanting social connection
concept.shortdesc: People who want to make friends, meet new people or attend together with partners and friends, including club members and non-members.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Couples, partners and friends who attend together or want help with relationships.
: People who want to make friends, widen their social circle or get out and be sociable.
: Club or group members, and sometimes non-members, as the people a session is open to.
: Catch-all entries such as people, anyone, all or mixed, giving no particular target group.
